scope: Deliver canonical CSV and XLSX imports with revision-bound two-administrator review, server-enforced commit control, atomic PostgreSQL verification, redacted failure evidence, and a required GitHub reliability gate while keeping imports disabled until test-server and organizational approval gates pass.

evidence: framework/design-change-requests/DCR-2026-006-governed-import-reliability.md records the approved change, affected surfaces, deployment condition, and rollback condition.
docs/quality/GATE-EVIDENCE.md keeps test-server and named organizational approval gates separate from automated evidence.
Required inventory-production GitHub run 17 passed at commit e702401eb2040e6c4803157e9a006dddde706755.
operations/Build-Delta-Package.ps1 and operations/Test-Delta-Package.ps1 require a versioned, hash-verified component delta and immutable migration IDs.
backend/src/imports.ts resolves importer, reviewer, permissions, and commit authority from the authenticated server session.
Backend authorization tests reject importer self-review and unauthorized direct API actions.
database/009-governed-import-reliability.sql grants import.review only through the Privileged Administrator role.
The browser journey requires two distinct non-importing Privileged Administrators on the same revision and hash.
backend/test/integration/importReliability.database.test.ts verifies revision locking, immutable reviews, idempotent concurrent retries, typed readback, and complete rollback in PostgreSQL 18.
e2e/import-reliability.spec.ts reconciles the committed correction through database, API, Search, and export.
database/Migrations/006-invmgmt-schema.sql is locked to deployed SHA-256 fc332b26717641edf8df3dee94b716925606d68f3b3ff2dfa914ac7f7dfe38ba.

database/Migrations/009-governed-import-reliability.sql owns the three new reliability tables, is transactional and uniquely journaled, supports clean-baseline replay, and marks existing open sessions NEEDS_REVALIDATION.
The PostgreSQL 18 GitHub job applies migrations and passes the database contract before integration tests.
Draft source metadata, rows, mappings, revisions, hashes, reviews, stage events, and results are persisted in PostgreSQL.
The browser correction remains intact through filtering, page navigation, review, commit, readback, Search, and export.
backend/test/importSources.test.ts covers UTF-8, Windows-1252, delimiters, malformed quoting, null bytes, formula injection, XLSX sheets, hidden sheets, merged headers, and formula rejection.
Equivalent golden CSV and XLSX inputs produce the same canonical draft in automated tests.
Backend source and workflow tests block duplicate headers, duplicate field mappings, duplicate serials, duplicate unique profile values, and unmapped required fields.
Mapping decisions are revisioned and any mutation invalidates earlier approvals.
frontend/src/pages/ImportPage.test.tsx covers row correction, inclusion changes, approval progress, and commit gating.
e2e/import-reliability.spec.ts proves a corrected Product Name survives revalidation, filtering, navigation, review, commit, API readback, Search, and export.
The commit endpoint rechecks mode, permission, draft revision, draft hash, two current approvals, and idempotency under a PostgreSQL lock.
PostgreSQL integration forces a mid-batch asset/model failure and verifies that no inventory row remains; concurrent retries produce one commit result.
The governed browser journey verifies completed data through Inventory API, Search, and CSV export after manual importer commit.
Frontend state invalidation refreshes Search, Inventory, Reports, Activity, import history, and category totals after commit.
Release 1.4.0 is delivered through the existing component-delta updater from the confirmed installed release 1.3.16.
The full baseline remains reserved for clean installation and disaster recovery.
The updater verifies installed version, package hashes, complete target component manifests, required migration IDs, and version contracts before publishing.
Failure handling restores switched application components and preserves the pre-update maintenance state.
The release workflow verifies liveness, PostgreSQL readiness, schema migration, API build, frontend build, and browser access.
The updater requires direct API readiness, IIS readiness, published web/API version compatibility, and all application routes after deployment.
